name: Golden Goose Egg
desc: Gain souls over time, as long as you are alive.

name: Mystic Burst
desc: Charges up over time with bonus spirit damage, causing abilities dealing more than 80 damage to deal additional damage.

name: Mystic Expansion
desc: Imbue an ability to increase its range and effect radius.

name: Mystic Regeneration
desc: Dealing spirit damage to enemy Heroes grants you Bonus regeneration. Stacks when dealing damage to different heroes.

name: Rusted Barrel
desc: Target an enemy to reduce their Fire Rate and Bullet Resistance.

name: Spirit Strike
desc: When you perform a Light or Heavy Melee attack against a hero, deal extra spirit damage with the attack and reduce the target's Spirit Resist.Cooldown is 2x longer for Light Melee hits.

name: Arcane Surge
desc: After you Dash-Jump, the next ability you use within 7s will have bonus Range, Duration, and Spirit Power.

name: Bullet Resist Shredder
desc: Reduces Bullet Resist on enemies when you deal spirit damage.

name: Cold Front
desc: Release an expanding ice blast that deals spirit damage and Slows targets it hits.

name: Compress Cooldown
desc: Imbue an ability to reduce its Cooldown.

name: Duration Extender
desc: Imbue an ability to increase its Duration.

name: Mystic Slow
desc: When the target takes spirit damage, they have their Move Speed reduced.

name: Mystic Vulnerability
desc: When an enemy takes spirit damage, they have their spirit resist reduced.

name: Quicksilver Reload
desc: Your imbued ability charges up over time with bonus spirit damage, bonus fire rate, and reloads bullets on use.

name: Slowing Hex
desc: Slows movement of enemy target. Also Silences their movement-based items and abilities.Increases the target's gravity.Does not affect target's stamina usage.

name: Spirit Sap
desc: Target an enemy to reduce their Spirit Resist and Spirit Power.

name: Suppressor
desc: When you deal spirit damage to enemies, you also reduce their Fire Rate.

name: Decay

name: Disarming Hex
desc: Disarms enemy target and reduces their Bullet Resist.

name: Greater Expansion
desc: Increases the range and effect radius of your abilities and items.

name: Knockdown

name: Radiant Regeneration

name: Silence Wave

name: Spirit Snatch

name: Superior Cooldown
desc: Reduces the Cooldown of your abilities.

name: Superior Duration
desc: Increases the duration of your abilities and items.

name: Surge of Power
desc: Imbue an ability with permanent Spirit Power. When that ability is used, gain bonus Move Speed and maintain full speed while attacking.

name: Tankbuster
desc: Charges up over time with bonus spirit damage, causing abilities dealing more than 165 damage to deal additional damage. Ignores Spirit Resistance.

name: Torment Pulse
desc: Periodically deals spirit damage to the closest two enemies nearby.

name: Arctic Blast
desc: Release an expanding ice blast that deals spirit damage, Freezing and then Slowing targets it hits.Slowed targets have their stamina regen frozen

name: Cursed Relic

name: Echo Shard
desc: Reset the cooldown of the imbued non-ultimate ability.This item's cooldown is increased by the cooldown of the imbued ability.

name: Escalating Exposure
desc: Dealing spirit damage applies a stacking Spirit Amp that increases your spirit damage to the target.

name: Ethereal Shift
desc: Instantly enter a void state and become Invulnerable for a short duration.

name: Focus Lens
desc: Target an enemy to Silence them. A portion of all damage dealt during the silence gets applied to the target when the silence wears off.

name: Lightning Scroll
desc: Damage from your ultimate applies a stun and deals bonus spirit damage after a short delay.

name: Magic Carpet
desc: Summon a Magic Carpet that will fly you away. While flying you are immune to slows and doing any action will dismiss the carpet. Cannot use abilities while the carpet is being summoned.

name: Mercurial Magnum
desc: Your imbued ability charges up over time with bonus spirit damage, bonus fire rate, and reloads bullets on use. Until your next reload, your bullets deal bonus spirit damage based on your Spirit Power.

name: Refresher
desc: Reset the cooldown of all your abilities and restore all your charges.

name: Scourge
desc: Apply Spirit Resist, Debuff Resist and an aura on a friendly target that deals damage to enemies proportional to their max health. Existing debuffs on the target are reduced.Can be self cast.

name: Spirit Burn
desc: Dealing significant spirit damage to an enemy within 5s causes an explosion dealing damage and a burn to that enemy. While burning, enemies take damage over time and receive reduced healing.The cooldown is per enemy, so

name: Transcendent Cooldown
desc: Reduces the Cooldown of your abilities and items.

name: Vortex Web
desc: Throw a vacuum grenade, pulling all enemies into a small area and applying Slowing Hex. Alt Cast to Target Unit Directly.

name: Frostbite Charm
desc: Imbued ability has its Cooldown reduced and gains Spirit Power. When the ability deals damage, freeze the target and apply bonus damage. Cooldown is per target.

name: Mystic Conduit
desc: Provides yourself and allies with a powerful spirit focused aura. Has reduced values on allies.

name: Mystical Piano
desc: After a short delay, enemies in the target area will be stunned and have their stamina depleted. After the stun they will be temporarily dazed.

name: Omnicharge Signet
desc: Imbue any active non-ultimate ability with Bonus Ability Charges. Already charged abilities receive more bonus charges.

name: Prism Blast
desc: You enter a void state and become untargetable and invincible for a short duration, during which lasers blast out and rotate around you.

name: Shrink Ray
desc: Reduces Model Size and grants Move Speed to the target. Allows usage of tunnels in this mode. Can be self-cast.

name: Unstable Concoction
desc: Consume a concoction that grants you Unstoppable and increased speed, health, spirit and weapon damage. After a short duration you die and explode, stunning nearby enemies and dealing damage based on your maximum health.

name: Grit
desc: Gain a Barrier for a short duration.

name: Healing Rite
desc: Grant Regen and Sprint Speed to the target. Gets dispelled if you take damage from enemy players or objectives. Can be self-cast.

name: Melee Lifesteal
desc: Your next Melee attack heals you. This heal is 30% effective vs non-heroes. Cooldown is 1.5x as long for Light Melee hits.

name: Rebuttal
desc: On a successful Parry against an enemy Hero, Heal yourself for the damage parried and returns that damage to the target, and temporarily gain increased damage.

name: Battle Vest
desc: While you are above 65% health, gain weapon damage and bonus fire rate.

name: Debuff Reducer
desc: Reduces the duration of all negative effects applied to you.

name: Enchanter's Emblem
desc: While you are above 65% health, gain bonus Spirit and Cooldown Reduction.

name: Enduring Speed
desc: Reduces the effect of enemy Move Speed penalties.

name: Guardian Ward
desc: Provide the target with a Barrier and temporary Move Speed. Can be self-cast.Cooldown is reduced by half when cast on someone else.

name: Healbane
desc: Your spirit damage reduces the enemy's Incoming Healing. If an enemy hero dies under this effect, you receive a large heal.

name: Healing Booster
desc: Increases the effectiveness of your healing.

name: Reactive Barrier
desc: Gain a Barrier when you are Stunned, Chained, Immobilized, Slept or Silenced.

name: Restorative Locket

name: Return Fire
desc: Automatically fire a bullet towards any attacker who damages you with their abilities or weapon.

name: Spirit Shielding
desc: Gain a Barrier whenever you take significant spirit damage from enemy Heroes in a small time frame.

name: Trophy Collector

name: Weapon Shielding
desc: Gain a Barrier whenever you take significant weapon damage from enemy Heroes in a small time frame.

name: Bullet Resilience
desc: When below 50% health, gain additional Bullet Resist.

name: Counterspell
desc: Your next parry protects you from the damage and effects of enemy abilities and items. On a successful spell parry heal and gain move speed and Spirit.

name: Dispel Magic
desc: Purge all non-ultimate negative effects currently applied to you. If any effects were removed, heal yourself and gain a move speed bonus. Cannot be used while Stunned or Slept.

name: Fortitude
desc: After not taking damage for a period, gain health regen.

name: Fury Trance
desc: Grants Fire Rate, Spirit Resistance and Move Speed, and removes the Move Speed penalty while shooting, but Silences you and disables stamina usage and regeneration.

name: Healing Nova
desc: Heal yourself and nearby allies.

name: Lifestrike

name: Majestic Leap
desc: Launch yourself high into the air and grant yourself a Barrier. While in the air, you can use the active again to drop down faster.Cannot be used for 5s if attacked by enemy Hero.

name: Metal Skin
desc: Become immune to bullets.

name: Rescue Beam
desc: Heals a target allied hero and yourself for a percentage of Max Health. Once while healing, you can Pull the target towards you. Can be self-cast.

name: Spirit Resilience
desc: When below 50% health, gain additional Spirit Resist.

name: Stamina Mastery
desc: Allows an additional use of Air Jump or Air Dash before landing.

name: Veil Walker
desc: Walking through a cosmic veil grants you Stealth, Heal and increased Move Speed.

name: Warp Stone
desc: Teleport straight ahead, gaining Bullet Resist.

name: Colossus
desc: Grow larger in size, gaining bullet resist, spirit resist, and melee damage. Nearby enemies suffer from slow and have reduced dash speed.

name: Divine Barrier
desc: Remove all non-stun debuffs from the target and provide them with a Barrier and Move Speed. Can be self-cast. Cooldown is reduced by half when cast on someone else.

name: Diviner's Kevlar
desc: Upon casting an ultimate ability gain a Barrier and temporary Spirit Power.

name: Healing Tempo

name: Infuser
desc: Gain Spirit Lifesteal and Spirit Power.

name: Inhibitor
desc: Your bullets build up to reduce the target's outgoing damage and apply healing reduction.

name: Leech
desc: Reduces the effect of enemy applied healing reduction.

name: Phantom Strike
desc: Teleport to an enemy target and pull them to the ground. Dealing damage, Move speed reduction and Disarm.

name: Plated Armor
desc: Gain a chance to either deflect incoming bullets, preventing all weapon damage or prevent all on-hit effects from bullets.

name: Siphon Bullets
desc: Your bullets temporarily steal Max HP from enemies. Enemies regain their stolen health when the debuff expires.

name: Spellbreaker
desc: The next instance of high spirit damage you take is significantly reduced.

name: Unstoppable

name: Vampiric Burst

name: Eternal Gift
desc: Periodically gain a random permanent stat buff.

name: Nullification Burst

name: Seraphim Wings
desc: When Airborne, You deal more damage and take reduced damage. Allows unlimited Air Dash and Jumping.

name: Shadow Strike

name: Close Quarters
desc: Deal additional Weapon Damage when in close range to your target.

name: Headshot Booster

name: Restorative Shot
desc: Your next bullet will heal you based on what target you hit.

name: Active Reload

name: Fleetfoot
desc: Gain bonus Move Speed and Slow Resistance.

name: Intensifying Magazine
desc: Increases Weapon Damage as you continuously fire your weapon.

name: Kinetic Dash

name: Long Range
desc: Deal additional Weapon Damage when beyond a minimum distance from your target.

name: Melee Charge
desc: Your next Heavy Melee attack against an enemy deals increased damage.

name: Mystic Shot
desc: Your next bullet deals bonus spirit damage.

name: Opening Rounds

name: Recharging Rush
desc: Dealing significant weapon damage replenishes a charge for each of your charged abilities.

name: Slowing Bullets

name: Stalker

name: Escalating Resilience

name: Express Shot

name: Headhunter

name: Heroic Aura

name: Hollow Point

name: Point Blank

name: Sharpshooter

desc: You have infinite ammo.

name: Runed Gauntlets
desc: Every time you land a heavy melee, your existing cooldowns get reduced.
